events.author: kofi-codes
events.title: Make search ignore upper and lower case
events.body:
Fixes #4

`search` now lowercases both the title and the query before comparing. Added a test with mixed case.

files.patch:
@@ -70,7 +70,7 @@ def cmd_remove(args):
 def search(tasks: list[Task], text: str) -> list[Task]:
-    return [t for t in tasks if text in t.title]
+    return [t for t in tasks if text.lower() in t.title.lower()]

@@ -38,3 +38,11 @@ def test_search_finds_matching_title(capsys):
+
+def test_search_ignores_case(capsys):
+    main(["add", "Call the bank"])
+    capsys.readouterr()
+    main(["search", "call"])
+    assert "Call the bank" in capsys.readouterr().out

@@ -70,7 +70,9 @@
 def search(tasks: list[Task], text: str) -> list[Task]:
-    return [t for t in tasks if text in t.title]
+    import re
+    return [t for t in tasks if re.search(text, t.title, re.I)]

events.author: li-wei
events.title: Add tests for remove
events.body:
Fixes #13

Two tests: removing an existing task, and removing an id that does not exist (exit code 1).

files.patch:
@@ -45,3 +45,17 @@
+def test_remove_existing(capsys):
+    main(["add", "temp"])
+    assert main(["remove", "1"]) == 0
+    assert load_tasks() == []
+
+def test_remove_unknown_id():
+    assert main(["remove", "42"]) == 1
